A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Gaussian Quant (GQ) and TDC work despite the changed title. Their main text, four figures, twenty tables, equations, and Appendices A–E are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original reconstruction, generation, ablation, and computational-performance results in Section 4 and the appendices, including ImageNet, COCO, and FFHQ experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including reconstruction comparisons, FFHQ generation results, codebook-seed experiments, and implementation timings.

M1.justification: The defining GQ quantization equations, TDC updates, two-stage pipeline, regularizer, and Stable Mean-KL variant are retained. Section 3.5 introduces an isolated 'log 3K' expression inconsistent with the unchanged equations; this appears to be a typographical slip and does not establish a revised procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain ImageNet and COCO reconstruction, ImageNet class-conditional generation, and FFHQ generation in Appendix D.4. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 5 relabels the existing MIRACLE constraint as 'MIRACLE / HiFiC' while retaining its rows and scores. Other comparator sets also match throughout the main text and appendices. Newly cited WeTok and iFSQ are not added to the reported evaluations.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix C retain the same stated splits, image resolutions, model configurations, bitrate settings, metrics, training budgets, and batch sizes. The added explanation of the existing mean-rate controller does not report a revised experimental setting.

E4.justification: The conversion, TDC, codebook-size, seed, dimensionality, two-stage-training, and regularization ablations are retained. Appendices B–E also preserve the Stable Mean-KL analysis, pixel-space error analysis, latent visualization, prior-posterior mismatch study, and license-plate failure case.

E5.justification: Table 8 retains separate results for codebook seeds 42, 43, and 44. Appendix D.5 retains the same statistical-estimation procedure and settings. Neither version reports confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings are retained throughout. For example, Table 1's UNet GQ result at 1.00 bpp remains 32.47 PSNR and 0.322 rFID, and Table 18's FFHQ GQ gFID remains 5.09. The qualitative panels reuse the same examples.

T1.justification: New Equation 6 explicitly specifies the MIRACLE/HiFiC mean-rate controller, including its target R* and multiplicative lambda update; v2 described this baseline qualitatively. The GQ theorems, assumptions, error bounds, and appendix proofs remain unchanged apart from equation renumbering.

C1.justification: The new title emphasizes training-free conversion, which both versions already claim. The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about GQ conversion, the codebook-rate relationship, reconstruction performance, and TDC's benefit to TokenBridge.

C2.justification: Section 6 newly acknowledges greater implementation complexity and additional hyperparameters, balancing these costs against eliminating STE and several VQ losses. The existing single-scale limitation and qualification about reconstruction versus generation are retained.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the supplementary-material code statement with an explicit GitHub repository address. Section 3.3 also documents the existing baseline's controller more precisely. Appendix C's implementation settings and Appendix D's CUDA code remain unchanged; repository contents are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: v3 adds HiFiC, WeTok, and iFSQ references and explicitly positions TDC as a per-dimension extension of MIRACLE/HiFiC rate control. The CUDA-related citation changes from Vonderfecht and Liu to Liu et al. for the same-titled work, rather than introducing another research dependency.

P1.justification: The title, affiliations, author note, and publication header change, with localized explanatory additions in Sections 3.3, 5, and 6. The section sequence and most prose are retained. Section 3.5 introduces the inconsistent 'log 3K' wording.

P2.justification: All figures and tables are retained. Table 5 expands its constraint label and adjusts column spacing, while added prose reflows the main-text layout. Figures 2 and 4 use JPEG-compressed versions of the same panels at unchanged pixel dimensions.

improvement.justification: v3 clarifies TDC's relationship to prior rate-control methods, acknowledges implementation and hyperparameter costs, and supplies concrete code-access instructions. These provide limited gains in explanation and transparency while preserving the empirical evidence and proofs. The new 'log 3K' inconsistency is a small clarity regression, so the net improvement is modest.
